question: What does a restore of the Cold Archive class cost per TB in total, once the Standard-class billing of the restored copy is added to the retrieval fee?
why: the restored copy is billed upfront at the Standard Multi Zone rate of USD 0.00002152 per GiB-hour (about USD 0.0157096 per GiB-month) for the days set in the restore request, which can exceed the retrieval fee of USD 0.01062 per GiB for a long window; the record names that charge but states no all-in restore price
